step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify visible components on the whiteboard:
- MongoDB (labeled 'MONGODB') -> actor/service: 'MongoDBAtlas'
- Kinesis Data Firehose (labeled 'KINESIS DATA FIREHOSE') -> AWS service: 'Firehose'
- Raw Zone S3 Bucket (labeled 'RAW ZONE S3') -> AWS service: 'S3'
- AWS Glue (labeled 'GLUE', with crawler bug and catalog icons) -> AWS service: 'Glue'
- Landing Zone S3 Bucket (labeled 'LANDING ZONE S3') -> AWS service: 'S3'
- Amazon Aurora (labeled 'AURORA') -> AWS service: 'Aurora'
- Amazon Athena (labeled 'ATHENA') -> AWS service: 'Athena'
- AWS Elastic Beanstalk (labeled 'ELASTIC BEANSTALK') -> AWS service: 'BeanStalk'
- CDN Cloud icon (labeled 'CDN') -> AWS service: 'CloudFront'
- AIS Middleware (labeled 'AIS' box at top) -> Third party system: 'ThirdParty'

2. Trace directed arrows on the whiteboard:
- MONGODB -> Kinesis Data Firehose
- Kinesis Data Firehose -> RAW ZONE S3
- AIS -> RAW ZONE S3
- RAW ZONE S3 -> GLUE (dashed line)
- GLUE -> LANDING ZONE S3 (dashed line)
- LANDING ZONE S3 -> AURORA
- LANDING ZONE S3 -> ATHENA
- ELASTIC BEANSTALK <-> AURORA (double-headed arrow)
- CDN <-> ELASTIC BEANSTALK (double-headed arrow)

3. Construct nodes and edges according to Cloudscape schema rules.

graph.name: Town Square Community Management Data Analytics Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture showing real-time operational database streaming into S3 raw zone, data transformation with AWS Glue, star schema staging in Aurora, and delivery to end users via Elastic Beanstalk and CloudFront.

nodes.name: MongoDB
nodes.notes: Operational database storing community application data

nodes.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
nodes.notes: Buffers incoming change streams and delivers to raw zone S3

nodes.name: Raw Zone S3
nodes.notes: S3 bucket storing raw JSON change stream data

nodes.name: AWS Glue
nodes.notes: Crawls raw data, updates catalog, deduplicates and transforms into star schema

nodes.name: Amazon Aurora
nodes.notes: Relational database holding star schema for benchmarking queries

nodes.name: Amazon Athena
nodes.notes: Queries curated data in landing zone for ad-hoc BI reports

nodes.name: AIS Middleware
nodes.notes: Middleware connecting external accounting systems to raw zone S3

edges.notes: Saves raw JSON data into S3 raw zone
Pushes accounting data into raw zone S3
Glue crawler inspects raw zone S3
Glue writes deduplicated/curated data to landing zone S3
Glue job transforms JSON to star schema in Aurora
Athena directly queries landing zone data via Glue Catalog
HTTP requests sent from UI host CDN to Elastic Beanstalk
Query results returned to Elastic Beanstalk
